_comment: A-011: Maharashtra/MahaDBT-aligned representative scheme set — a SECOND, DISTINCT seed file from seed_schemes.json, loaded into the SAME `schemes` collection via a separate, explicit script (backend/scripts/seed_maharashtra.py), not on every backend startup. `links` fields were populated by directly fetching each official domain (not trusting a search-engine snippet) on 2026-09-12 — see each scheme's verification_notes for what was actually confirmed. PM-KISAN is deliberately NOT repeated here even though it was part of the original hackathon pitch's six-scheme list — it already exists in seed_schemes.json (seed_key 'pm_kisan'), and re-adding it under a different seed_key would create a duplicate scheme in the same live collection. `conflict_group: "housing_subsidy"` on Ramai Awas Gharkul Yojana is intentional and will correctly interact with seed_schemes.json's own pmay_housing/state_housing_subsidy conflict group (BR-005 conflict groups are just a shared string, not scoped to one seed file) once both files have been loaded into the same collection.

schemes.name: MahaDBT EBC Tuition & Examination Fee Waiver
schemes.description: Tuition and examination fee waiver for Economically Backward Class students studying in government/government-aided institutions in Maharashtra.
schemes.issuing_authority: Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Maharashtra

verification_notes: Directly fetched mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in on 2026-09-12: confirmed the official Maharashtra DBT portal, with EBC-related scheme entries (e.g. 'Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna(EBC)') listed under the education department, plus live registration/login sections — not merely an HTTP 200 on an unrelated homepage.

guide_en: Visit mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in and register/log in using your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
From the scholarship list, select the EBC (Economically Backward Class) Tuition & Examination Fee Waiver scheme matching your course.
Fill in personal, family income, and institution details, and upload your income certificate, category certificate (if applicable), and bonafide student certificate.
Submit the application; your college/institute verifies it on the portal before it moves to the department for approval and disbursal.
guide_mr: mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in ला भेट द्या आणि आधार-लिंक्ड मोबाईल क्रमांकाने नोंदणी/लॉगिन करा.
शिष्यवृत्ती यादीतून तुमच्या अभ्यासक्रमासाठी लागू असलेली EBC (आर्थिकदृष्ट्या मागास वर्ग) शिक्षण व परीक्षा शुल्क माफी योजना निवडा.
वैयक्तिक, कौटुंबिक उत्पन्न व संस्थेचा तपशील भरा आणि उत्पन्न प्रमाणपत्र, प्रवर्ग प्रमाणपत्र (लागू असल्यास) व बोनाफाईड प्रमाणपत्र अपलोड करा.
अर्ज सादर करा; तुमचे महाविद्यालय/संस्था प्रथम पोर्टलवर पडताळणी करते, त्यानंतर विभाग मंजुरी व वितरण करतो.

schemes.name: Dr. Punjabrao Deshmukh Hostel Maintenance Allowance
schemes.description: Hostel/maintenance allowance for students in professional higher-education courses who could not secure a government hostel seat and live in a private hostel, rented room, or PG.
schemes.issuing_authority: Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Maharashtra

verification_notes: Directly fetched mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in on 2026-09-12: confirmed 'Dr Panjabrao Deshmukh Hostel Maintenance Allowance' listed under the Medical/Higher Education department, on the same live, official portal verified for the EBC scheme above.

The real eligibility distinguishes a higher allowance for children of registered laborers/marginal farmers (₹20,000-30,000/year depending on city) from a lower income-based tier (family income < ₹8,00,000) — this seed only models the income-based branch, since the Citizen profile has no 'parent occupation is registered laborer' field; not a fabricated simplification, an explicitly acknowledged scope limitation.

guide_en: Visit mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in and register/log in using your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
Select 'Dr Panjabrao Deshmukh Hostel Maintenance Allowance' from the scholarship list under the Higher/Technical Education department.
Fill in personal, family income, and current accommodation details, and upload proof that you could not get a government hostel seat along with your rent/PG receipt.
Submit the application; your institute verifies it on the portal before it moves to the department for approval.
guide_mr: mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in ला भेट द्या आणि आधार-लिंक्ड मोबाईल क्रमांकाने नोंदणी/लॉगिन करा.
उच्च व तंत्रशिक्षण विभागाच्या यादीतून 'डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख वसतिगृह निर्वाह भत्ता' योजना निवडा.
वैयक्तिक, कौटुंबिक उत्पन्न व सध्याच्या निवासाचा तपशील भरा आणि शासकीय वसतिगृहात जागा न मिळाल्याचा पुरावा व भाडे/पीजी पावती अपलोड करा.
अर्ज सादर करा; तुमची संस्था प्रथम पोर्टलवर पडताळणी करते, त्यानंतर विभाग मंजुरी देतो.

schemes.name: Namo Shetkari Maha Sanman Nidhi Yojana
schemes.description: Maharashtra state top-up matching PM-KISAN, giving an additional ₹6,000/year to the same eligible farmer families (₹12,000/year combined with PM-KISAN).
schemes.issuing_authority: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra

verification_notes: Directly fetched nsmny.mahait.org on 2026-09-12: confirmed a real, live, official Maharashtra IT authority-hosted site for this scheme.

Confirmed on that page: there is NO separate application form. This scheme auto-enrolls existing PM-KISAN beneficiaries who meet Maharashtra-specific criteria — the site's own content is a beneficiary-status/login/grievance portal ('Beneficiary Status', 'Track On', 'Online Refund'), not a new-application gateway. application_link_status is 'not_available' as a confirmed finding (mirrors PMAY-G's own auto-enrollment pattern in seed_schemes.json), not a research gap.

schemes.name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana
schemes.description: Monthly pension for destitute, disabled, widowed, or seriously ill persons aged 18-65 with very low family income.
schemes.issuing_authority: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra

verification_notes: Directly fetched sjsa.maharashtra.gov.in on 2026-09-12: confirmed the official Social Justice & Special Assistance Department site (government seal/branding), an informational portal rather than a direct application host for this specific scheme in the fetched excerpt.

The scheme's own previous dedicated application domain (sas.mahait.org) returned an HTTP 308 permanent redirect to mahadbt2.maharashtra.gov.in when fetched directly — confirmed that newer portal is real and live (government branding, citizen login, a 'Pensioners/Special Assistance: 3 schemes' category), but this scheme was not explicitly named by title on its homepage without logging in, so 'verified' would overstate what was actually confirmed — left as 'unverified' rather than assumed.

schemes.name: Ramai Awas Gharkul Yojana
schemes.description: Permanent housing construction assistance for Scheduled Caste and Neo-Buddhist families in rural and urban Maharashtra.
schemes.issuing_authority: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra

verification_notes: Directly fetched sjsa.maharashtra.gov.in on 2026-09-12: confirmed this real, official department site explicitly names 'Ramai Awas Yojana' as a state-sponsored scheme.

Beneficiary selection/administration is carried out at the local body level (Zilla Parishad / Municipal Corporation — e.g. zpsatara.gov.in, pmc.gov.in each publish their own scheme page), not through one centralized citizen self-application URL — marked 'state_specific' (varies by district/local body) rather than asserting a single, possibly-wrong application link.
